summary: Added an exact-build identity gate to the automatic runtime analyzer. DXVK runtime evidence now cross-checks session_manifest SourceSha/Backend against packaged BUILD_INPUTS and one-click preflight SourceSha/ResolvedBackend before allowing a source-specific success interpretation. Concrete mismatches fail closed even if host-owned bridge/directFrames telemetry appears successful; missing optional evidence is classified as incomplete rather than fabricated into a mismatch.

review.architecture: Collector already copies BUILD_INPUTS.json and VR_ONE_CLICK_PREFLIGHT.json into the session directory before Analyze-OutRunVRSession.ps1 runs. The missing layer was analyzer-side correlation with session identity.
review.lifetime_sync: No transport resource, run generation, producer/consumer ACK or GPU lifetime code changed.
review.stereo_correctness: No WVP/stereo/HUD/menu/visual path changed; this task changes only evidence attribution.
review.performance: No runtime hot-path code changed. Identity parsing occurs after the game/host session during collection/analyzer execution.
review.adversarial: A synthetically successful host-owned DirectGPU fixture with mismatched source identity must report DXVK_BUILD_IDENTITY_MISMATCH instead of DXVK_HOST_OWNED_DIRECTGPU_ACTIVE. Incomplete legacy/manual metadata must not be mislabeled as mismatch.

failure_context.failure: PowerShell Set-StrictMode error: '$backend' was read by identity-derived flags before session Backend and BuildIdentity variables were initialized.
failure_context.repair: Moved complete session/build/preflight identity calculation before identity flags and status precedence. No runtime/transport code was changed.
failure_context.repeat_policy: The failing SHA was not rerun unchanged.
